summary.headline: Passionate Places in Enigmatic Signs
summary.text: Chapter 136 discusses passionate places or limbs in the enigmatic zodiacal signs Aries, Taurus, Leo, and Capricorn, linking their rising degrees and the faces of Scorpio, Taurus, Leo, and Capricorn with psychic passions, licentiousness, bodily injuries, and unnatural pleasures. It continues with the effects of Venus in these signs when observed by Mars or Saturn, alongside remarks on the powers of fixed and bright stars.
